title: Verify: Send loading label unit tests
summary: Unit tests assert the 'Sending…' label while pending and 'Send' after settle.
description: New test file using mocked submitContribution with a controllable deferred promise.
acceptance_criteria: Button name is 'Sending…' with aria-busy true while the request is pending.
Button name is 'Send' again after the request resolves and after it rejects.

steps.action: Create the suite with the vi.mock block from tests/contributionQuotaGate.test.tsx. Test 1: type 'hello', submitMock returns a manually controlled promise, fireEvent.submit the form, assert screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Sending…'}) exists with aria-busy true; resolve with contributionFixture (tests/fixtures/api) and waitFor getByRole('button',{name:'Send'}). Test 2: same with submitMock.mockRejectedValue(new Error('x')) and assert the label returns to 'Send'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionLoadingLabel.test.tsx
